# Decide
Normalises messy data (text dates, text amounts, odd status text), removes duplicates,
then picks the stage each invoice has reached:
Heads-up -3 days, Friendly 3, Firm 10, Final 21.
Sends only if that stage is later than the last one sent. A bad row becomes
an "error" item and never stops the batch.

=Final alert sent for Invoice no: {{ $('Needs a reminder?').item.json.invoiceNo }}, Client name: {{ $('Needs a reminder?').item.json.clientName }}, {{ $('Needs a reminder?').item.json.clientEmail }}, for the invoice amount: {{ $('Needs a reminder?').item.json.amount }} {{ $('Needs a reminder?').item.json.currency }} please follow up.

=FAILED to send FINAL NOTICE email to {{ $('Needs a reminder?').item.json.clientName }} ({{ $('Needs a reminder?').item.json.invoiceNo }}; {{ $('Needs a reminder?').item.json.amount }} {{ $('Needs a reminder?').item.json.currency }}) Contact them yourself today at: {{ $('Needs a reminder?').item.json.clientEmail }}.

# Invoice Follow-Up Bot
Runs daily. Reads the invoice sheet, decides each invoice's reminder stage,
emails clients, records what was sent, and sends the owner one daily summary.
Paid and Disputed invoices are never chased. Each stage is sent once.

# Send and record
One email path for all stages; the wording comes from a template table.
The sheet is updated only after Gmail succeeds, so failed sends retry on the next run.

# Final notice
Final notices also alert the owner on Discord so he can call the client.
If the Final email fails, a separate alert says to contact the client today.

# Daily summary
Always sends, even on quiet days. Shows planned vs actually sent, overdue totals,
and what needs attention, with a warning if anything doesn't add up.
Keep this branch lowest on the canvas: n8n runs branches top to bottom
and the summary must run last.
